Stage dev hub

Install the dev client once, then load any branch over the air.

1 · Install the dev client (Android)

The rolling APK — always the latest native build. Open on the phone, or scan.

Download APK

2 · Load a branch preview

Every push publishes a JS preview. Open the branch's PR and tap the Preview check on the latest commit, or find the run in App preview actions — its summary carries the deep link and QR.

Per-branch URL

In the dev client, "Enter URL manually" accepts https://bundler.stage.box/<branch> — e.g. /main — and always loads that branch's newest bundle. Slashes in branch names become dashes (feat/x → /feat-x), or just paste the path with slashes.

Manual launcher

Have a manifest URL (u.expo.dev/…)? Build the dev-client deep link with the preview launcher.
